restrictions.text: Travel 1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset only; no Saturdays, Sundays or holidays (New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) and none after noon on the weekday before Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas. Loads within 12' wide and 85' long that keep traffic speed may run until noon Saturday.

Curfew 7-9 am and 4-6 pm: statewide for loads 16'+ wide, 100'+ long or over 14' high; in business districts for loads 14'+ wide, 90'+ long or 14'+ high. Local curfews: Binghamton (>10' wide or >72' long), Syracuse 10-mi radius (>10' or >85'), Hudson/Kingston/Newburgh/Poughkeepsie (>11'), Utica/Amsterdam (>12'), Albany & Rensselaer I-787/I-90/I-87 (>13').

Overweight-only loads up to 125% of legal weight (legal dimensions, traffic speed) may travel 24/7; heavier ones follow the daylight, weekend and holiday limits above (modeled as over 100,000 lb gross - legal weight is axle-based).
No travel when visibility < 1,000 ft or pavement hazardous from rain, sleet, snow, ice, fog, flood or wind; permitted vehicles must stay 2,000 ft apart.

notes: NYSDOT permits cover only State highways; the NYS Thruway, New York City and other local roads need their own permits.
Superloads (Type 1S): route survey, letter of responsibility, vehicle diagrams, surety bond (PERM 14) and local permits; traffic control plan and State Police escort per NYSDOT policy/rates.
Police count is 1 per trigger; the manual does not say how many troopers - check the State Police Escort Policy.
Escort on multi-lane highways for over-height only loads is modeled as a front height-pole car; verify against permit conditions.
Night travel may be allowed on request in Westchester, Rockland, Dutchess, Putnam, Orange, Nassau and Suffolk counties.
Holidays are modeled with the noon-before rule for all six holidays; 154-1.2(a) closes New Year's Day itself only (no noon-before), so New Year's Eve afternoon is held here although NY allows it.
Business-district and city curfews (7-9 AM, 4-6 PM) are local and not modeled; the statewide curfew for 16'+ wide, 100'+ long or over 14' high is.
